requirements_summary: SaaS knowledge-base RAG. Moderate indexing scale (~500k-1M documents). High steady-state QPS target (200-400 QPS). Must use embeddings for retrieval and a neural reranker for top-K precision. P95 query latency target <=120ms for search-only responses; acceptable higher for assistant flows if reranker runs async. Strong cost constraints: target blended cost <$0.002 per user query at scale. Hosted API preferred for speed to market; eventual interest in Dedicated if unit economics improve.
qps_target: 200-400 QPS (sustained), spikes to 700 QPS during peak hours
latency_slo: search p95 <=120ms, rerank added latency budget <=100ms (prefer async)
cost_sensitivity: high — target blended cost <$0.002/query; wants transparent token and embed unit math
model_preferences: open models for embeddings (256- or 384-d), small cross-encoder reranker (BERT-base or distilled) for top-10 re-rank. Quantized variants acceptable for cost savings.
reranking_requirements: Top-10 rerank on CPU/GPU fallback; must support async rerank pipeline with streaming results; A/B testing for reranker variant integrated into rollouts. Need explainability for reranker scores for compliance audits.
